name: Unmapped source account
rationale: an account absent from the ERP chart cannot be mapped and must land in the exception file

name: Intercompany amount mismatch
rationale: an entity-pair intercompany mismatch is invisible until the elimination engine matches the pair, which is Phase 4. Both trial balances still close and every Phase 3 control is correct to pass

name: Missing FX rate
rationale: a missing rate must block the period rather than translate at zero

name: Duplicate journal identifier
rationale: a duplicated journal breaks the declared lineage grain

name: Invalid cost centre
rationale: a cost centre absent from the master is an unresolved dimension key

name: Malformed localised amount
rationale: an amount that does not parse under the declared locale

name: Posting date outside its period
rationale: a posting date outside its own accounting period

name: Payroll misclassified across the gross margin line
rationale: payroll moved across the gross margin line still balances; only the margin reconciliation finds it

name: Unbalanced journal
rationale: a journal whose lines do not sum to zero

name: Posting before the consolidation effective date
rationale: a posting before the entity's consolidation effective date
